notes.title: HotFix and New Languages : Update V0.1
notes.content:
Level 1
● First parkour is now more easier.
● Hard Disk level is now more easier.
● Added tutorial repetition for multiple failed attempts on Hard Disk level.

Level 2
● Fixed the issue where the box in the first place could be held from the bottom.
● Checkpoint set for first place.
● Fan Puzzle is now more understandable.
● Moving Platform is now more understandable.

Level 2 Boss
● Increased the cooldown between Boss waves attacks.
● Hitbox of Boss waves attacks adjusted.

Level 3
● The rotation speed of the first fans has been increased.

Level 5
● Fixed the position of lever opened with Chickenrobot.
● Clarity for the last part.
● When the character dies in the last part, he no longer returns to the beginning of the level.

General Fixes
● Fixed some low Fps bugs.
● F key interaction indicator now works properly when controlling Chickenrobot.
● New pressure plate voice has been added.
● Decal Lines is now more understandable.

Added New Language Supports (Translated with Translate Programs)
● Chinese
● German
● Italian
● Japanese
● Korean
● Rusian
